title: Firebase Auth — Backend Auth-API Design
summary: Technical design for backend Firebase auth: TEXT-keyed identity model, schema migration, and GET /api/auth/session provisioning endpoint.
notes: Status is 'Design (awaiting spec sign-off)', not Accepted, so not a locked ADR. Contains an ADR-like '## Decisions (locked during brainstorming)' section plus goals/non-goals (PRD-like), but dominant content is API contract (endpoint, request/response schema), data model, and schema migration mechanics -> classified SPEC. ADR/PRD signals noted but did not override due to precedence rule (SPEC content stronger and more extensive than the decisions list).
